question: Fed rate hike in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is increased at any point between January 1, 2026 and the Fed's December 2026 meeting, currently scheduled for December 8-9, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market may not resolve to "No" until the Fed has released its rate change decision following its December meeting.

The primary resolution source for this market will be the official website of the Federal Reserve (https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm), however a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

# Fed rate hike in 2026: research brief (information through 2026-08-29)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-29: My fetch of the Fed's open market page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm) was refused by the proxy, so I could not read the official table directly.
- 2026-07-29: Credible reporting says the FOMC kept the target range at 3.50%-3.75%, which puts the upper bound at 3.75%. The vote was 9-3. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/fed-rate-decision-july-2026.html)
- The minutes of the July 28-29 meeting are posted on the Fed's site, but I could not fetch them. [Fed minutes](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomcminutes20260729.htm)

## 2. Current status
- As of 2026-08-29, I found no reports of any hike in 2026. The upper bound stayed at 3.75% through the July meeting, so the question is still open.
- 2026-07-29: Three regional Fed presidents dissented in favor of a 25 bp hike: Hammack (Cleveland), Kashkari (Minneapolis) and Logan (Dallas). [Kiplinger](https://www.kiplinger.com/investing/live/fed-meeting-updates-and-commentary-july-2026), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/fed-rate-decision-july-2026.html)
- 2026-08-28: Chair Kevin Warsh said at Jackson Hole that rate hikes "may be needed" in the coming months, but he did not commit to September. [ADN/AP](https://www.adn.com/nation-world/2026/08/28/fed-chair-warsh-signals-rate-hikes-may-be-needed-with-inflation-stubbornly-elevated/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-28/29: According to AP, Warsh said inflation is still too high and underlying trends have not meaningfully improved. The Fed's preferred inflation measure was 3.7% in July. After the speech, markets put a September 15-16 hike at roughly a coin flip, up from about one-third beforehand. Adam Posen said that not hiking in September could raise credibility questions. AP called the next price report, due just before the meeting, potentially decisive. [ADN/AP](https://www.adn.com/nation-world/2026/08/28/fed-chair-warsh-signals-rate-hikes-may-be-needed-with-inflation-stubbornly-elevated/), [ABC/AP](https://abcnews.com/Business/wireStory/warsh-raises-stakes-feds-meeting-takeaways-jackson-hole-136055905), [RealEstateNews](https://www.realestatenews.com/2026/08/28/economists-betting-on-a-rate-hike-after-fed-chair-speech)
- 2026-08 (date not given): Governor Lisa Cook said she is prepared to act if disinflation does not show up soon. [American Banker](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/humid-july-cpi-report-puts-pressure-on-fed-to-hike)
- Mid-August 2026: July CPI rose 0.1% m/m and 3.4% y/y, down from 3.5% in June. Core CPI was +0.2% m/m. Energy fell 1.5% on the month, but gasoline was still about 25% higher than a year earlier because of the Iran war. Afterward, CME FedWatch put a September hike at 38.1%, and economists said nothing in the report "demands" a September hike. [Fox Business](https://www.foxbusiness.com/economy/cpi-inflation-july-2026), [Scotsman Guide](https://www.scotsmanguide.com/news/july-cpi-report-meets-forecasts-dims-outlook-for-september-rate-hike/)
- 2026-08-07: July payrolls fell by 23,000, and May-June were revised down by a combined 103,000. Unemployment dipped to 4.1%, but participation fell to 61.4%. Traders cut September hike odds from 57% to 44%. [babypips](https://www.babypips.com/news/headline-us-nonfarm-payrolls-july-2026-jobs-report-fed-rate-outlook), [Fox Business](https://foxbusiness.com/economy/us-jobs-report-july-2026)
- 2026-07-13 to 07-23: Hike odds rose with oil prices after Trump reinstated the blockade of Iranian ports near Hormuz. FedWatch put a July hike at about 36-38%. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/23/fed-interest-rate-odds-oil-jobless-claims.html), [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/simonmoore/2026/07/23/markets-see-chance-fed-hikes-next-week-at-july-meeting/)
- Trump keeps calling for lower rates while defending Warsh, whom he appointed. [ADN/AP](https://www.adn.com/nation-world/2026/08/28/fed-chair-warsh-signals-rate-hikes-may-be-needed-with-inflation-stubbornly-elevated/)

## 4. Base rates
- The last Fed hike was in 2023. Since then the Fed has either cut or held, and the range had come down to 3.50%-3.75% by 2026.
- Historically, it is rare for the Fed to start hiking within about a year of its last cut. One Yahoo headline said traders gave Warsh a 42% chance of doing something that "has only happened once in the past 36 years". I could not open the article to confirm what that refers to or when it was published. [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/traders-warsh-42-chance-doing-082651946.html)
- In the July meeting, a 9-3 vote with three dissents for a hike is an unusually hawkish split.
- Three meetings remain in the window: September 15-16, October 27-28 and December 8-9.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Around 2026-07-08: Polymarket's "Fed rate hike in 2026?" market was at about 57-61%, on roughly $4M in volume. [CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/polymarket-fed-rate-hike-odds-2026/), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/polymarket-predicts-60-odds-of-fed-rate-hike-in-2026-crypto-investors-take-note)
- July 2026 (exact date unclear): Another report had Polymarket at 64% for a 2026 hike. [CryptoBriefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/fed-rate-hike-in-2026-likely-polymarket-assigns-64-probability/)
- August 2026 path for Polymarket's September-hike contract, per an aggregator I could not verify:
  - about 48.5% on 08-05
  - about 36.5% on 08-08, after the jobs report
  - about 24.5% around 08-15 to 08-17
  - about 30.5% on 08-28
  - about 49.5% on 08-29, after Warsh's speech

  [MacroOdds](https://macroodds.com/blog/fed-rate-hike-odds-september-2026)
- Around 2026-08-28/29: CME FedWatch was reportedly near 56% for a September hike, with Kalshi and Polymarket at about 48-49%. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/economy/policy/articles/fomc-september-2026-odds-rate-201618784.html)
- I could not find a confirmed reading of the full-year "hike in 2026" contract dated 08-28 or 08-29. Logically it should sit at or above the September-hike probability. Polymarket's own page is the place to check. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/fed-rate-hike-in-2026)
- I found no Manifold figure.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-09-04: August jobs report.
- About 2026-09-10/11: August CPI. AP described this as potentially decisive for September.
- Ongoing: oil prices and the Iran/Hormuz situation, which have driven the energy-led inflation.
- 2026-09-15/16: FOMC decision, with new projections (dot plot). This is the question's stated resolution date. If the Fed holds, the October 27-28 and December 8-9 meetings would still count under the criteria.

- **October or December, given no September hike:** With the Chair already signaling and inflation stuck, I estimate 35-40%. Weak jobs data argues against a much higher figure.
- **Combined:** 0.50 + 0.50 × 0.37 ≈ 0.68. That is slightly above the July full-year market of 57-64%, which is justified by Warsh's 08-28 speech pushing September odds up sharply.
- **Adjustment:** I trim slightly for the labor-market deterioration and the historical rarity of reversals.

Probability: 67%
